title: Retry fetch uses http.DefaultClient instead of the configured client
body:
### Issue Description

`downloadToDirectory` (`pkg/tmpdir/url.go`) builds an HTTP client from `URLOptions` and fetches the URL. It first tries to untar the response. If the body is a plain `Containerfile` rather than a tarball, the untar fails and the URL is fetched a second time. That second fetch uses `http.DefaultClient` instead of the configured `httpClient`, so the TLS and proxy options from the command line don't apply to it.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. first create a temporary directory and change to it: `d=$(mktemp -d); cd "$d"`
2. create ssl keys: `openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout k.pem -out c.pem \
  -days 1 -subj /CN=127.0.0.1`
3. create a simple containerfile: `echo 'FROM docker.io/library/alpine:latest' > Containerfile`
4. run local file server: `openssl s_server -accept 8443 -cert c.pem -key k.pem -WWW -quiet & pid=$!`
5. run buildah command without tls: `buildah build --tls-verify=false https://127.0.0.1:8443/Containerfile`

### Describe the results you received

Error: prepping temporary context directory: Get "https://127.0.0.1:8443/Containerfile": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate relies on legacy Common Name field, use SANs instead


### Describe the results you expected

STEP 1/1: FROM docker.io/library/alpine:latest
COMMIT
--> <sha>
<sha>
